_readme: Template for config/<book>.json. Copy it, delete the keys that start with an underscore, and fill in the rest.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation only; render_html.py ignores them. Paths are relative to eBooks/_build.
Keep theme, cover_style and shadows exactly as they are here (README section 3 and 4).
Photos: if the manuscript has none, borrow from wellpeps-site/public/images/<area>/ (README section 6, step 2).
_topic: Running head, rendered as 'SMART PATIENT GUIDE TO <topic>' in tracked caps. Keep it short.
_title: Cover headline (Lora, white on the cover shade). Over 22 characters switches to the smaller 'long' size.
title: SEXUAL WELLNESS MEDICATIONS
_cta_url: Target of the CTA button and the www.wellpeps.com link on the CTA page.
_cover: Cover photo. cover_focus is [x, y] in 0..1 for object-position; cover_crop is [left, top, right, bottom] fractions trimmed before use. cover_meta is only used by the plate/minimal covers.
_series: The other guides, listed on the disclaimer page. Add 'url' to an entry once the guide is public and body-text mentions of that title become links.

_card_images: Named images that outline card items reference with "image": "<name>". Rendered at card_image_ratio (default 9:5, centre-cropped). Only use a product photo whose label matches the card copy.
_card_image_ratio: Aspect ratio of the card image slot as w/h. Match it to the photos (the website product shots are 4/3) so bottle caps are not cropped.
_sections: Keyed by the outline section number ('00', '01', ...) plus 'decide' and 'cta'. Every key is optional.

00._kicker: Text in the navy band. Defaults to the headline in caps, truncated to 46 characters; always set it.

01._image: Section photo floated right, sized in inches. focus is [x, y] object-position; set it so nobody is cropped at the frame edge.
01._image_after: How many text blocks run full width before the figure enters the flow (default 0 = beside the lead).
01._image_min_w: Lets the paginator shrink the figure in 7% steps down to this width (inches) before dropping it. Omit to drop it outright when the page is too full.

02._hero: Two photos inset side by side above the text, rounded and lifted. Replaces 'image'.

03._headline_icon: Small icon rendered after the headline (the GLP-1 checklist page uses one).
03._dense: One type step down on a long page. Use only when page_fit reports CONTINUED and copy cannot be trimmed.
03._lead_small: 13pt lead instead of 15.5pt. Use only to hold a long lead to two lines.
03._full_width_head: Headline and lead wrap edge to edge instead of balancing into equal half-lines. Use on a page with no figure, where balanced lines leave the right side looking like a missing photo.

14._image: Why WellPeps page: team photo at the right of the intro. Defaults to the GLP-1 media image14.png.

decide._image: Optional wide band photo above the closing line on the Before You Decide page.

cta._kicker: Defaults to GET THE COMPREHENSIVE CARE YOU DESERVE.
